title: Component 1/4: Web3 Legal Ease: Streamlining Legal Barriers for Business Growth

ms.promise:
The research phase will provide us with all the essential elements needed to run the project.
・Identify key target startups.
・Conduct interviews with relevant founders and CEOs of target startups to understand their needs in regards to EU regulation.
・Conduct initial research on EU regulations relevant to Web3 startups, including basic templates and guides for the most common Web3 legal needs (utility tokens, asset tokens, CASP compliance guidelines... ).
・Set up the advisory board.
ms.criteria:
・Compile a list of at least 5 key target startups.
・Conduct at least 3 interviews with relevant founders and CEOs of key target startups.
・Initial legal content reviewed and approved by at least two independent legal experts in Web3 regulations.
・Appointment of the advisory board.
ms.report:
